title: EduGenesisSettings
description: Versioned, portable settings for EduGenesis OS. Mirrors EduGenesisSettings in packages/contracts/src/index.ts. Secrets live only in an untracked local override; the committed default carries an empty apiKeys map.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. A file older than this is migrated on load; a file newer than this is rejected rather than silently misread.

host.description: Interface the local server binds to. 127.0.0.1 keeps the Settings UI off the network.

port.description: TCP port for the local server and Settings UI.

dataDir.description: Data folder, RELATIVE to the project root. Absolute paths, drive letters, UNC paths and any '..' segment are rejected so the project stays portable.

primary.description: Provider id used for Tier 1 routing.

secondary.description: Provider id used for Tier 2 routing.

local.description: Optional local model id used for Tier 3 routing.

apiKeys.description: Provider credentials. Never logged, never committed, never returned in full over HTTP.

accessibilityGuardian.description: Route every learner-facing emission through the Accessibility Guardian.

offlineBundle.description: Enable the Tier 0 signed offline bundle (no model provider required).

telemetry.description: Enable pseudonymous interaction telemetry. Off by default.

publicAnchoring.description: Publish the ledger Merkle root to a public anchor. Off by default; requires Board sign-off.

budgetUnits.description: Hard cap for the default budget pool. Zero disables paid tiers.

mediaBudgetBytes.description: Media budget per emission in bytes.

confidenceThreshold.description: Confidence below which an uncertainty marker is mandatory.

extra.description: Keys found in an older settings file that this schema does not know. They are preserved here by the migration step so nothing is ever dropped silently.
